description: Published us-public-schools records from the pinned PublicDataHub CC0 deposit. A documented column projection is encoded; missing numeric values remain absent.

rights.attribution: PublicDataHub, Quan Nguyen, PublicDataHub: United States federal reference data as bulk CSV (2026.08), version 2026.08.29, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22152382. Original agencies are identified per file.

conversion.selection: All source rows, in source order.
conversion.serialization: Protocol Buffers compiler 3.25.3 descriptors, Python protobuf 6.33.1; deterministic=True. Fields are assigned in schema order and batches contain consecutive source rows.
conversion.missing_values: Missing/blank numeric and string fields are absent; explicit nonblank zero values retain optional-field presence. No random or generated values are added.
